# Shrink-only allowlist of raw `gh` spawn sites (#9985).
#
# Enforced by loom-daemon/tests/gh_spawn_choke_point.rs: the tree's raw sites
# (`Command::new("gh")`, `Command::new(gh…)`, `fn gh_bin…` outside
# src/gh_invocation/) must match this list EXACTLY, as a multiset. Format:
# `<path relative to loom-daemon/> | <trimmed source line>`, byte-sorted.
#
# - Never add an entry: build the new site through
#   `crate::gh_invocation::GhInvocation` instead.
# - When you migrate a site, delete its line — a stale entry fails the test.
# - #10089 widened the scan to path-qualified resolver calls
#   (`Command::new(crate::gh_invocation::gh_bin())`), which had slipped past
#   it. The three `fleet/drain.rs` entries are that pre-existing debt made
#   visible, not new sites: they set the child's `PATH` (which also steers
#   program lookup), an env the facade does not carry yet. The
#   `cli/merge_pr_tree_checks.rs` entry (main's #10026) is the same kind of
#   debt: it pipes the comment body on stdin, which the facade cannot do yet.
#
# Empty list == migration complete.

src/cli/merge_pr_tree_checks.rs | let child = Command::new(loom_daemon::gh_invocation::gh_bin())
src/fleet/drain.rs | let mut comment_cmd = Command::new(crate::gh_invocation::gh_bin());
src/fleet/drain.rs | let mut edit_cmd = Command::new(crate::gh_invocation::gh_bin());
src/fleet/drain.rs | let mut view_cmd = Command::new(crate::gh_invocation::gh_bin());
